test_cases.title: A customer found by QAL number opens its details
acs: DERIVED: A customer listed by QAL search opens its details page - 15 customers (data/seed/samples.json)
assumptions: The admin site runs at http://localhost:1946 and the user is signed in as an Admin (Windows identity dt2\ns000134).
Data table: the Examples table lists every row; each row is one execution.
Read-only: nothing is created, saved or deleted, so no data cleanup is needed.
Representative sample: one row stands for the 15 similar rows; the full list is kept in docs/full-examples/ and can be restored.

steps.action: Type the QAL number of the row and click Search.
Click the customer in the results.
Check the page for a server error message.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

open_questions: DERIVED criteria come from read-only probes; confirm they are the intended behaviour.
